title: IPC admin.trust.set result
description: What a trust set did, from minor 2.10 (below it the set answers empty-result). `set`: the policy is as asked, changed by the set or already so. `refused`: NOTHING was written, and `refused` names the rule. A REFUSAL IS AN ANSWER, not an error; `detail` is for a log, never parsed. A set refused by the policy (this profile's own identity, the allowlist's ceiling) is still the error `InvalidArgument`, and a write that fails the error `Internal` (ADR-0028).

refused.$comment: Present exactly when outcome is refused. superseded: the set came from an admin connection admitted before the one whose set for the same peer the daemon last applied, so the later connection's set stands (LOCAL-IPC.md, Cancellation mapping and request concurrency).
